Question
========

What is the distance between the extreme cardinal points of Great Britain (in miles)? 

##ANSWER1##

What is the approximate area of the Isle of Man (in square kilometres)?

##ANSWER2##

Solution
========

- The distance between the extreme cardinal points of Great Britain was 603 miles.
- The approximate area of the Isle of Man was 571 square kilometres.
